title: Nice Light Dutch Emmentaler Cheese Skillet
description: A jammy and light Dutch dish featuring Emmentaler cheese, perfect for a energizing meal. This kosher-friendly recipe is made with a soffritto-base and cooked in an iron teppan.
instructions: Preheat the iron teppan over medium heat.
Melt the butter in the teppan and add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery.
Cook the soffritto-base for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are softened.
Add the shredded Emmentaler cheese to the teppan and stir until it starts to melt.
Create 4 wells in the cheese mixture and crack an egg into each well.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Cover the teppan with a lid and cook for an additional 5 minutes, until the eggs are cooked to desired doneness.
Serve the Nice Light Dutch Emmentaler Cheese Skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
